name: movie-to-excel
description: Keep a private, local-first Excel archive of movies, TV series, and documentaries.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a private local viewing archive in Excel.
interface.longDescription: Identify movies, TV series, and documentaries from titles or posters, verify public metadata, and maintain a private local Excel archive without accounts, social features, or platform lock-in.
interface.defaultPrompt: Add the movie, TV series, or documentary I provide to my local Excel viewing archive.
